artworks.title: Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Rembrandt's National Gallery of Art panel sets Zeus and Hermes at the humble table of Philemon and Baucis — hospitality rewarded in a glow of Dutch Golden Age light.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Jordaens fills the cottage with Flemish abundance as the disguised gods accept the old couple's meal — Baucis and Philemon's poverty turned into festive welcome.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Elsheimer's small night scene places the gods inside a candlelit hut — Baucis and Philemon's kindness painted as intimate German Baroque drama.

popCulture.title: Baucis and Philemon
popCulture.description: The poor Phrygian hosts of Zeus and Hermes remain Ovid's emblem of hospitality rewarded — a thatched hut become temple, and intertwined trees.
